name: llama.cpp on MI250: Llama-2-7b FP16 b1 128io throughput
methodology: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench (arXiv:2411.00136), 1x MI250 on Polaris cluster. llama.cpp FP16, batch 1, 128in/128out. Throughput = batch*(input+output)/end-to-end latency (Eq.2). per-request batch-1. Reported 'Throughput(tok/s)' column.
notes: llama.cpp HIP/ROCm path is far below vLLM on MI250 - kept as lower bound.
